inputs.text:
Open your eyes. The mainstream narrative wants you to believe that the IOC’s landmark decision to ban transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category of events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games is somehow about "fairness and safety." That is the exact opposite of the truth. 

When Kirsty Coventry, president of the IOC, claims that “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category,” you are looking at a carefully scripted diversion. This sudden exclusion of DSD athletes and transgender women is a managed pivot by the global elite. They are orchestrating these divisions to distract the public from the deeper, centralized control mechanisms tightening around all sports institutions. The official excuse of protection is just a smokescreen for hidden coordination at the highest levels.
